evidence: One bounded collection mismatch remains. Under the frozen task, tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:40 makes anchor 5 require that visible states remain easy to distinguish 'in each offered theme', but tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:43 says 'Review the offered appearance for colour and contrast; one theme is enough.' The latter permits sampling one member of the collection claimed by the anchor. The public instruction.md:7 requires only a single clear colour scheme. The frozen template's visual prompt:27-28 explicitly reviewed every offered theme, whereas this task narrowed the plan without fully narrowing its anchor. Other inspected plural checks are explicit: functional/prompt.md:227-236 requires all five separate unsupported-family attempts; :310-355 covers both timer and all three rejection fixtures; :429-433 compares every current saved record and all recorded fixture histories; :465-479 compares complete recorded snapshots and both race outcomes, including exactly one new revision. Legitimate side effects are accommodated at functional/prompt.md:149 (native input value after Stop), :197 (app-owned title/status), :207 (caught blocked operations), :383 (remaining status labels), and :430 (record order/display metadata). The raw index hashes all matched, but its scripted golden observations and screenshots do not exercise a multi-theme judge counterexample or establish configured-judge results.
counterexample: A submission offers a readable default theme and a second theme whose console/status text has indistinguishable foreground/background colours. Following visual/prompt.md:43, the judge may inspect just the default theme and award anchor 5 even though visual/judge.toml:40 requires each offered theme to preserve distinguishability. Conversely, a conforming single-scheme implementation has no second theme to traverse and must remain eligible for full credit; a repair must not make multiple themes mandatory. Conforming functional alternatives that update the host title while running, retain a static stopped preview, or reorder a library are already expressly allowed by the cited guards.
suggested_fix: Align the visual colour anchor with the authorized single-appearance review by replacing 'in each offered theme' with wording about the reviewed appearance; alternatively, explicitly require reviewing every offered theme without requiring an app to supply multiple themes.
